title: GamesWorldPublishedPayload
description: games.world.published v1 (OpenVibe.Games apps/server/src/worlds/worldRoutes.ts): a player published one of their creator worlds for the first time, so it is listed at https://openvibe.games/worlds and anyone can join it. Written to Games' outbox in the transaction that publishes it; unpublishing and publishing again does not repeat it. OpenVibe.Quest credits the owner's "Publish a creator world" quest from it. Envelope: subject { type: world, id: <world id> }, actor the owner, visibility public.

world.description: The creator world id. Also the envelope subject id.

owner.description: The player who made and published it.
